column1: # Anchor engines. Ratings are CCRL single-CPU, snapshot 2026-11-06 ("-" = not rated on that list).
# id
# build runs inside the cloned repo; binary is the path it produces, relative to the repo.
# uci_options: space-separated fastchess option.NAME=VALUE pairs (book off, SyzygyPath=@TB@ if supported), or "-".
# repo/ref "TBD" means the exact rated source hasn't been confirmed yet; build-anchors.sh skips it.
# Provenance (2026-11-06): stellar, mora = official repo at the rated version. vice = third-party copy of 1.0
# (official repo starts at 1.1). sungorus = unofficial mirror (official page needs login).
# weini: xboard-first, UCI "partial and buggy" - unusable with fastchess. cinnamon v2.5: tagged CMake
# config is debug/ASan and links gtest; needs a hand-patched build before it can be used. Builds untested.
# Batch 2 (2026-11-06): mora11, smallbrain, fatalii05/06, tantabus = official repos at exact tags. fatalii has no
# Cargo.lock at its tags, so its dependencies resolve to current versions (may differ slightly from the rated binary).
# smallbrain 1.1.0's types.h uses uint8_t without <cstdint>; GCC 13 needs the include added (no behaviour change).
# Rung A blitz gauntlet uses: vice, mora11, smallbrain, fatalii05, sungorus, tantabus, fatalii06 (rated on both lists).
